prompt: When being asked by a stranger in the street do they have a watch, people usually look at their watches and give them the time of day. If they have a watch, why don't they just say "yes"?
response: Most people look at their watches to give the exact time, ensuring they provide accurate information. It's a natural gesture that often accompanies giving the time. Even if they just say "yes," the person asking usually expects the time as well.
